videos.title: The year that changed everything 🥹
videos.description: One year of loving you. One year of becoming, too. And if this first year has taught me anything, it’s that I’ll never stop falling in love with you 🧸 💌 #happybirthday #motherhood

videos.title: I waited years for this moment 🥹
videos.description:
Wait, what do you mean i have a cookbook? 🥲

From the bottom of my heart, thank you. This book wouldn't exist if you didn’t make our recipes, if you didn’t believe in me, if you didn’t champion this, for years asking, “do you have a cookbook?” You were sure about it long before i was. This book exists because of YOU! Thank you 🥹!!

Simply Plants comes out Oct 20th, but you can pre-order it now here: https://www.pickuplimes.com/book/simply-plants/

Gahh I can’t wait for you to hold it!! 🌱 + keep
